config_schema.description: Binding filter for `computer::frame-changed`. `session_id` is required: a viewer follows one desktop; unknown keys fail the registration.

session_id.description: The computer session whose frames to follow.

config_schema.title: FrameBindingConfig

description: The newest screencast frame of one session changed (a new frame was stored, or the frame was cleared because the screencast or session stopped). Config: { session_id } (required). Payload: { session_id, epoch, frame_seq, change, width, height, mime?, bytes?, timestamp }; no image: read it with computer::frame. Latest state only: intermediate notifications are coalesced for slow consumers, nothing is stored or replayed.

oneOf.description: A new frame was stored; read it with `computer::frame`.
The stored frame was dropped (screencast stopped, capture failed, or the session ended). Nothing to read until the next `updated`.

bytes.description: Encoded image size in bytes (`updated` only).

epoch.description: Identifies this incarnation of the session in this worker process (ms when it was created or restored). `frame_seq` restarts at 1 when `epoch` changes; compare `(epoch, frame_seq)` to order frames.

frame_seq.description: Sequence of the newest stored frame (monotonic within an epoch). For `cleared`, the sequence of the last frame that was stored.

mime.description: Image mime of the stored frame (`updated` only).
